literal: all things possessing, at the time of need will-help good-defenders that-which-possesses [is] a fortress
translation: A fortress is that which possesses all necessary provisions and holds good defenders who will help in times of need.
modern: எல்லாப் பொருட்களையும் தன்னுள் கொண்டதாகவும், நெருக்கடியான நேரத்தில் உதவக்கூடிய நல்ல வீரர்களை உடையதாகவும் இருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the two most critical internal assets of a fortress: material supplies and human resources. The phrase 'எல்லாப் பொருளும் உடைத்தாய்' emphasizes that the fort must be self-sufficient, holding all necessary provisions to withstand a long siege. Furthermore, 'இடத்து உதவும் நல்லாள்' highlights the need for capable and loyal defenders who will fight effectively when the situation demands it. A true fortress is defined by possessing both these material and human strengths.
